name: Omatravel
author: qempexe
description: Track visited countries and cities with multiple profiles, themes, a chronological travel path, stats, time travel, export and a zoom-banded GPU globe atlas.

barWidget.description: Travel atlas with a spinning globe

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Up to 8 characters shown in the bar, for example an emoji.

schema.label: Show counts
schema.description: Countries and cities next to the icon.

schema.label: Left click
schema.description: What a left click on the widget does. Right click always opens the settings.

schema.label: Middle click
schema.description: What a middle click on the widget does.

schema.label: Countries in the tooltip
schema.description: How many countries the bar tooltip lists before "+ N more".

schema.label: Cities per country
schema.description: How many cities the tooltip lists under each country.

schema.label: Globe side
schema.description: Which side of the atlas the globe sits on. Your lists take the other side.

schema.label: Show flags
schema.description: Country flag emoji in the lists and the tooltip.

schema.label: Travel path on the globe
schema.description: Draw arcs between your dated visits, in order.

schema.label: City labels on the globe
schema.description: Label cities as you zoom in.

schema.label: Atlas theme
schema.description: Colors of the atlas and the globe. Follow Omarchy updates the moment you switch your theme. Custom uses the three colors below.

schema.label: Background
schema.description: Custom theme background. A hex like #1a1b26.

schema.label: Text
schema.description: Custom theme text. A hex like #c0caf5.

schema.label: Accent
schema.description: Custom theme accent: selected parts, pins and the travel path.

schema.label: Window opacity
schema.description: Background opacity of the atlas. Text, globe and buttons stay solid.

schema.label: Roundness
schema.description: Corners of the docked atlas. 0 is square, 24 is very round.

schema.label: Window tint
schema.description: How much of the accent color washes over the background. 0 keeps it plain.

schema.label: Window outline
schema.description: Draw the edge of the docked atlas in color instead of a plain neutral line: the theme's window border gradient, one of its colors, or the accent.

schema.label: Outline gradient
schema.description: When your theme's window border is a gradient, the outline runs through all its colors, at the same angle.

schema.label: Outline color
schema.description: The one color of the outline when it isn't a gradient. The border colors come from your theme's window border, and fall back to the accent when it has none.

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: Text size in percent. 100 is normal.

schema.label: Spacing
schema.description: How much air there is around the edges of the atlas.

schema.label: Open as
schema.description: Where the bar icon opens the atlas. You can always pop it out or dock it back from the header.

schema.label: Width
schema.description: How wide the atlas opens.

schema.label: Height
schema.description: How tall the atlas opens.
